return_immediately.description: Flag if newly created Object ID should be returned without waiting for the asset itself and all its nested assets to be applied.  You can sort by the same fields available when filtering a view.

fields.description: Custom Fields require the `cf_` prefix and must be formatted as a JSON object. Example: `cf_eb1234567890-c676-4c10-9012-345678901234`
